metadata.indication: ALK-positive NSCLC: advanced after crizotinib (00401a), advanced first-line (00401b), or adjuvant after complete resection at high risk of recurrence (00401c).

metadata.schedule_summary: Take alectinib twice daily with food, every day, with no planned rest week. After surgery, treatment lasts up to 24 months, stopping sooner for recurrence or unacceptable side effects. For advanced cancer, treatment continues until progression or unacceptable side effects under the oncology plan.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss every dose modification with the Consultant. Do not combine or multiply dose reductions. Confirm current dose, indication, recovery and concurrent limitations.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00401 Version 6. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: NCCP v6 and current EMA SmPC reconciled for v0.84.24; independent review pending.

indications.description: Adult ALK-positive advanced NSCLC previously treated with crizotinib.
Adjuvant after complete resection in adult ALK-positive NSCLC at high risk of recurrence. NCCP: stage IB (tumour ≥4 cm) to IIIA, ECOG 0–1.
indications.reimbursement_note: N/A is the printed NCCP entry, not confirmation of reimbursement or lack of reimbursement; verify access separately.
indications.duration: Until recurrence, unacceptable toxicity or 24 months, whichever occurs first

treatment.schedule_summary: Alectinib 600 mg orally twice daily with food, continuously. Adjuvant: maximum 24 months; advanced: until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

eligibility: Adult ALK-positive NSCLC by validated test; adequate organ function.
Advanced: first-line or previously treated with crizotinib.
Adjuvant: complete resection, stage IB (tumour ≥4 cm) to IIIA, ECOG 0–1; confirm stage-edition mapping.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to alectinib or any excipient.
monitoring: Baseline ALK test, FBC, renal/liver profile, CPK, blood pressure and ECG.
Liver profile every 2 weeks for first 3 months, then every 4 weeks or as clinically indicated.
FBC and renal profile every 4 weeks.
CPK every 2 weeks for first month, then as indicated or for muscle symptoms.
Blood pressure and pulse as indicated. NCCP says ECG prior to cycle 2, then as indicated: continuous dosing has no defined cycle length, so first repeat ECG timing requires local confirmation.
dose_modifications: Discuss every modification with Consultant. Standard 600 mg twice daily; reductions 450 then 300 mg twice daily; discontinue if 300 mg twice daily is not tolerated.
Current-dose and recovery context required before restart; simultaneous limitations are not multiplied.
QTcF retained as context without an invented numeric alectinib dose row.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP v6 page 4 minimal to low oral risk; local policy. No routine infusion premedication.

supportive_care.oral_administration: Swallow whole with food twice daily; do not open/dissolve. Make up missed dose only if next is more than 6 hours away. Do not double; after vomiting wait until next scheduled dose.
